name: The Buffet
notes: 5 photos, all of the same printed buffet placemat menu. Photo 3 is a wide shot of the whole sheet; photos 1, 2, 4, 5 are close-ups of individual sections. Some sections (soups, salads, desserts) show slightly different item text between the wide shot and the close-ups, suggesting two printed revisions of this placemat were photographed and merged here; all legible items from both are included. No prices are printed anywhere (all-you-can-eat buffet), so price is omitted throughout. Flavor/variety lists (soups, salads, sushi, nigiri, cakes, cookies, pies, ice cream) are each recorded as one dish with the options in the description, matching how the board itself groups them.
